rationale: The agent appears to have located the user via name and zip and retrieved user details, which may satisfy basic authentication. However, the agent executed order-changing writes—modifying a pending order (item swap for i9) and canceling another pending order—without any explicit user confirmation shown in the conversation. Policy requires confirmation before any order-changing action. Additionally, there is no clear evidence the modified/canceled orders were verified as belonging to the user, nor that the selected replacement matched the user's stated preferences (256GB SSD, silver) or that any price differences and payment method changes were confirmed. Using a specific payment method (paypal_5914760) without confirmation further breaches the confirmation requirement. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
